omission_basis: The omitted 19.25 m/s row has the smallest approved DLC 6.4 fatigue weight and is bracketed by retained 18.0 and 21.5 m/s rows.
selection_basis: One immutable TurbSim realization at each retained speed provides an execution and raw-versus-complete checkpoint spanning both response bands, the highest-ranked modal-overlap neighborhoods, the 3 m/s bridge to the uniform campaign, and the 35 m/s DLC 6.4 endpoint.
reuse_contract: Every selected case is executed in its final path inside the sealed 102-case campaign root. A later extension must classify and reuse exact completed results rather than rerun them.
limitations: The checkpoint contains one realization per wind speed and cannot establish realization spread or seed convergence.
The checkpoint omits the one-way path and cannot isolate the imposed-spectrum mechanism from response feedback.
The checkpoint is not a complete weighted DLC 6.4 result and excludes DLC 6.1 U50.
Turbulent response is not expected to be rotor-periodic; half-record peak equality is diagnostic only.
The checkpoint is engineering execution and load-screening evidence, not physical validation, fatigue life, certification loads, or certification evidence.
